#   Thinned from 1939 rows to 201 by equal steps in deflection; the peak row

#   tendons and anchorage as PRC, jacked to 450 kN total.
#
# TEST SETUP (paper, section 2.3)
#   Beam 8500 mm long, rollers 250 mm from each end -> clear span 8000 mm.
#   Two actuators 3000 mm from each roller: shear spans 3000, constant moment
#   region 2000 mm. One jack under displacement control at 3 mm/min, the other
#   force-following. Tested at 160 days, after the long-term stage.
#
# CONSISTENT WITH THE DATA ITSELF, checked before the paper was read:
#   Ra + Rb = F1 + F2 to 1e-3 (simply supported, nothing else applied), and
#   M1/Ra = M2/Rb = 3.0000 m in every row of every beam -- the shear span.
